transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I understand we need to hold a coverage huddle for the Advanced Chemistry teacher's upcoming three-day absence next month. Before we can post anything to staff, I'll need to review and approve both the coverage roster and the instructional plan. I believe we have a draft plan that uses a single substitute, regular classroom activities, and the standard make-up-work process — but I'd like to hear from each of you on whether there are any relevant updates or concerns I should know about before I make my decision. Let's start with the department chair.

transcript.text: I need to flag a concern with the draft plan. I entered the practical in the department calendar this week, but I had not yet forwarded the calendar note to Ms. Morgan, so she may not have been aware of this when reviewing the draft.

This student needs a printed make-up packet available before the absence begins, so the standard online make-up process will not work for them.
